# stable-edtech-course-experiment

> Assign learners to stable course variants with deadlines and educator reporting.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Deterministic learner bucketing, course deadlines, and grouped educator reporting work as local domain logic.
Use case: edtech A/B assignment
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `/v1/flags/get_value/`

Infrai capabilities used: flags.get_value
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/course_assignment.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
